title: Planning puts a kb root's _anchors.csv in the touches of a content item that rewords a cited DOC fact, and its worker re-anchors it
goal: Planning's rule in skills/sprint/SKILL.md names a kb root's _anchors.csv as a touch of an item that rewords or adds a DOC fact, as it names expansions.csv for a reworded fact; precheck warns of a committed item whose touches name an article of a kb root and lack that root's _anchors.csv when its goal words a DOC fact reworded or added; agents/worker.md tells a worker that rewords or adds a DOC fact to re-anchor it with factdiff.py anchor --file (SP-tcis5f23: BG-7amw5rq6 and BG-bwlmvhq7 reworded DOC facts without _anchors.csv in their touches so the review found the reworded postgres and nftables facts unanchored and three nftables rows orphaned, ST-ko6bkda5)

run: import sys;a=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();b=open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines();x=any('expansions.csv' in l and '_anchors.csv' in l for l in a);y=any('factdiff.py anchor' in l for l in b);print('plan step names _anchors.csv:',x,'worker role re-anchors:',y);sys.exit(0 if x and y else 1)
